title: A/P Summary: 30 vendors per page, none repeated or skipped
custom_preconds:
Setup file (for Claude sessions; a tester does not need it)

Preconditions

  • You are signed in as a user with the "Admin" role, with {Location-A} as your current location.
    For example: {Location-A} is Staging Heavy Duty - 9919.
  • Between 31 and 90 vendors have open documents on today's date.
  • Starting screen: A/P Summary (Reports, then "A/P Aging Summary" under ACCOUNTS PAYABLE in the left menu) is open in a desktop browser window 1440 px wide, as opened from the Reports menu.
  • If any record above is missing, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_steps:
1. Choose "Download (CSV)" from the ⋯ menu.
  2. Open the CSV and count the vendors in it (each name once).
  3. Count the vendors on the first page and note the last one.
  4. Go to the next page (or scroll until the next ones load).
  5. Read every page to the end, writing down each vendor's name.
  6. Click the "Total" header.
  7. Read every page again, writing down each name.
  8. In the Past due filter, tick "1-30 days" and "91+ days".
  9. Read every page again, writing down each name.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 1: the CSV downloads.
  • Step 2: note the number of vendors (for example 46).
  • Step 3: exactly 30 vendors.
  • Step 4: the next page starts with the vendor that comes right after the last one of the first page, not a repeat.
  • Step 5: every vendor appears exactly once and the count equals the CSV's.
  • Step 6: the rows sort by Total, largest first.
  • Step 7: in this sort too, every vendor appears exactly once and none is missing.
  • Step 8: the report reloads with only those two ranges.
  • Step 9: every vendor left by the filter appears exactly once; none repeats between pages.

Whether the next 30 come by page buttons or by scrolling is question 5; story SV-11531 still says "Paging (30 rows per page)" for every report, PRD v5 is followed.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "A/R and A/P Report Sorting, Export and Location Filter", Confluence 947650561, version 5 (21 Oct 2026, Chris Ward), read 22 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-11315, story SV-11531 (Story 1, Reports open in QuickBooks name order)

  • S1-R8: “A/R Summary, A/P Summary, A/R Collection and A/P Unpaid Invoices show 30 customers or vendors per page. A/R Detail and A/P Detail show each bucket's first 100 lines, then load more as the user scrolls (S4-R4). Paging never repeats or skips a customer, vendor or row, in any sort.”
